content.what_it_is: Version 3.0 FUNWAVE-TVD documentation and user manual (Release Dec 2016): it records version changes, derives fully nonlinear Cartesian and weakly nonlinear spherical Boussinesq equations, conservative/well-balanced forms, MUSCL-TVD/HLL/SSP-RK numerics, breaking/wetting-drying/sponge/wavemaker/wind/MPI algorithms, installation and the complete input/output vocabulary, validation examples, stability guidance, references, and Appendix-A component expansions (lines 1-2830).
entities: Title, authors, acknowledgements, abstract, and source URL (lines 1-126)
Introduction: Boussinesq scope, legacy-noise motivation, hybrid finite-volume/finite-difference formulation, breaking, shoreline, MPI (lines 212-281)
Theory and governing equations: velocity decomposition, moving reference elevation, conservation and momentum equations (lines 282-400)
Weakly nonlinear spherical equations, cylindrical projection, correction factor, conserved variables (lines 401-546)
Numerical schemes: compact conservative form, spatial discretization, fourth/second-order MUSCL, limiters, HLL fluxes, SSP-RK and CFL (lines 547-711)
Wave breaking, wetting-drying, boundary conditions, and three sponge-layer formulations (lines 712-808)
Internal wavemaker, regular/irregular/TMA generation, wind, wave-height calculation, and MPI parallelization (lines 809-984)
Users' Manual: program outline, installation flags, compilation, input parameters, file formats, output switches, spherical inputs, nesting, and output naming (lines 985-1460)
Examples: Hansen-Svendsen breaking, Mase-Kirby random waves, Berkhoff shoal, Vincent-Briggs mound, Luth submerged bar, conical island, OSU shelf/island, and one-way nesting (lines 1461-2318)
Appendix A expansions of U1, V1, U2, V2, U3, V3, U4, V4 and vorticity terms (lines 2530-2830)

unresolved: Version 3.0 says periodic boundary conditions were implemented in the parallel code using Sherman-Morrison (lines 207-211), while the input manual later labels periodic boundaries as only for serial code (within lines 1201-1400).
The initial-condition parameter is written INT_UVZ in the user-manual list (within lines 1001-1200), whereas benchmark input cards and surrounding restart discussion use INI_UVZ.
The Mase-Kirby example assigns HIGH_ORDER=THRID (within lines 1601-1800), while the allowed spatial-scheme token elsewhere is THIRD.
The conical-island example sets NumberStations=16 and describes sta_0001 through sta_0016, but then names sta_0022 for gauge 22 (within lines 2001-2200).
The nesting prose states a 1 m initial solitary-wave amplitude, while both Grid_A and Grid_B input blocks set AMP=0.1 (within lines 2201-2400).

The manual defines the moving-reference constants as zeta=-0.53 and beta=0.47 in the theory section, but later describes Beta_ref=-0.531 as beta in the input vocabulary; the relationship between the input name and theoretical symbols is not clarified.
